features: Stunning 13-Inch Display with Pro-Grade Performance – Boasting an ultra-sharp 3504 × 2190 resolution across a large 13-inch LCD panel, a silky-smooth 144Hz refresh rate, up to 800 nits of peak brightness, and 99% DCI-P3 cinema-grade colour coverage, this display delivers razor-crisp visuals, fluid motion, and true-to-life colours — making it perfect for gaming, streaming, creative work, and everything in between.

Powered by Latest Snapdragon 8s Gen 4 Processor – Built on the advanced Snapdragon 8s Gen 4 (SM8735P) platform, this 8-core chip intelligently balances a high-performance core clocked at 3.2GHz, three power cores at 3.0GHz, and four efficiency cores at 2.8GHz and 2.0GHz — delivering blazing-fast speeds for demanding tasks while keeping things power-efficient for everyday use.

More Space, More Speed, More Freedom – Whether you're storing movies, games, or thousands of photos, 256GB of fast UFS 4.0 storage with expandable microSD support up to 2TB means you'll never run out of room; 8GB of LPDDR5x RAM keeps apps running smoothly, while Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6.0 ensure you stay connected at the fastest speeds available — at home, in the office, or on the go.

4 JBL Speakers, Dolby Atmos & Dual Cameras Built In – Four JBL-tuned speakers with Dolby Atmos bring concert-quality sound to your hands, while the 13MP rear camera with flashlight and 8MP front camera cover everything from low-light photography to sharp, smooth video calls — making this the complete package for entertainment and everyday capture.

Massive 10200mAh Battery with 45W Fast Charging Included – Packed with a large 10200mAh integrated battery delivering up to 12.5 hours of continuous YouTube streaming, this device is built to last through your longest days; and when it's time to recharge, the included 45W quick charger tops it back up in no time — so you spend less time tethered to a wall and more time doing what matters.
Sensors: Accelerometer, Gyroscope, Hall, RGB sensor
